name: claude-pacing
description: Pacing for Claude Code: spend the weekly plan allowance on purpose over a ladder of models.

plugins.name: pacing
plugins.description: Use better models and still save tokens: top tier model does the hardest work, cheaper models take easier work as subagents. 4 agent roles (reader, verifier, implementer and researcher) each stay with the session and keep notes per project, and a long session hands its work over to a new one. A status line shows the budget and each tier’s share.
